CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_relation (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    source_key varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    target_lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    relation varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    primary_stack varchar(128),
    stacks text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    concepts text[] NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_relation_distinct_lessons CHECK (source_lesson_id <> target_lesson_id),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_relation_kind_check CHECK (
        relation IN (
            'implementation',
            'practice',
            'comparison',
            'reference',
            'prerequisite',
            'continuation',
            'see_also'
        )
    ),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_relation_concepts_nonempty CHECK (cardinality(concepts) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_relation_primary_stack_member CHECK (
        primary_stack IS NULL OR array_position(stacks, primary_stack) IS NOT NULL
    ),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_relation_identity_unique UNIQUE (source_lesson_id, target_lesson_id, relation)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_relation_source_lesson_idx
    ON lesson_relation (source_lesson_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_relation_target_lesson_idx
    ON lesson_relation (target_lesson_id);
